Ukraine’s General Staff reports strikes overnight Sept 13 on two refineries in Russia. Slavyansky refinery in Slavyansk-na-Kubani caught fire and Taneco refinery in Nizhnekamsk had a tank ignited.

Ukrzaliznytsia says Russia struck the locomotive of a passenger train in Volyn, 2km from the Polish border. The crew got an early warning from a monitoring group and no one was hurt. https://t.co/DYGLDIyxCV

Sybiha says Russia’s strike on the Yahodyn border crossing is Putin’s terror knocking on the doors of the EU and NATO. He urges partners to act now with a full trade embargo, a full entry ban, and full sanctions on Russia’s military industry. https://t.co/f1AORYJ8HB
